text: The messaging service shall provide an operation that sends a unicast message to a specified destination address.

definitions_and_context.text: A unicast message specifies one destination address. Receipt and destination address observations refer to that same selected message.
An address denotes an opaque endpoint identity. Only equality between addresses is modeled; address arithmetic and a finite address range are not required.
The multicast time-to-live (TTL) parameter is a hop count. This fixture requires a configuration operation without specifying a value, range, elapsed-time limit, or router implementation.

context.example_scope: Authored examples for testing capability availability, a guarded recipient relation, and hop-count configuration. The examples are not extracted from a study corpus and do not assert successful delivery, eventual receipt, or a deployed implementation.

text: If a selected unicast message is received, its receiving address shall equal that message's specified destination address.
